cards.headline: The tape: a broad bid, 61% of energy names green
cards.body: SPX +0.28% · WTI -2.48% · Brent +1.29% · NatGas -3.95%. 61% of 67 energy names are green — a broad bid. Grid, Storage & Electrification is doing the heavy lifting at +2.54%.

cards.headline: Grid, Storage & Electrification leads, Shale & E&P lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Grid, Storage & Electrification at +2.54%; weakest is Shale & E&P at +0.05%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.headline: VRT is the standout at +5.70%
cards.body: Leaders: VRT +5.70%, BE +3.30%, UUUU +2.31%, GEV +2.21%, LEU +2.06%. Laggards: FANG -0.47%, ARRY -0.30%, SHEL -0.18%, MPLX -0.12%.
cards.watch: Hot means attention, not direction — watch whether the leaders hold the bid or fade into the next session.
